name: Testing What AI Can Actually See and Understand
gist: Papers build benchmarks to test whether vision-language models can handle real images, spatial reasoning, and visual understanding tasks that humans find natural — from design aesthetics to ancient pottery.
explain: Vision-language models—systems that look at images and answer questions about them—sound simple in theory: show the model a picture, ask what it sees, check if it is right. But in practice, vision understanding is far trickier than it seems. A model might recognize objects but miss spatial layout; it might handle photos taken in studios but fail on blurry, messy real-world images; it might spot a dog but not understand whether the dog is happy or scared, chasing or being chased. This subtheme is about building tests that expose what vision models can and cannot actually do.

The core difficulty is that human vision understanding is so automatic and intuitive that we forget how much is involved. Understanding a picture means parsing objects, their positions, colors, sizes, actions, relationships, context, and emotions all at once. Tests have to slice through that complexity and ask: does the model truly see spatial reasoning, or just memorize patterns? Can it understand design aesthetics, or just label surfaces? Does it work on ancient pottery the same way it works on modern photos? The papers here build benchmarks that test these specific kinds of understanding, often catching places where models that seem impressive at first actually fail on details humans find natural.

Researchers build these benchmarks by carefully collecting images paired with questions that probe a specific skill. Some focus on spatial reasoning—asking how objects relate to each other in 3D space. Others test visual understanding of domains people have studied for centuries: art history, architecture, ancient objects. Still others gather real, messy images from the internet or cameras rather than clean studio photos, to test whether models work in the wild. The goal is to move beyond generic vision tests toward benchmarks that measure real-world visual understanding.

papers.title: Can Vision-Language Models Answer Face to Face Questions in the Real-World?
papers.contribution: IVD reveals that existing models fall far behind human performance and identifies main sources of performance gaps, while showing fine-tuning can significantly reduce the gap.

papers.title: FRIEDA: Benchmarking Multi-Step Cartographic Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Evaluates eleven state-of-the-art LVLMs and reveals that models struggle with complex cartographic reasoning requiring cross-map grounding.

papers.title: LiveWeb-IE: A Benchmark For Online Web Information Extraction
papers.contribution: The benchmark enables granular assessment of WIE systems across complexity levels, with VGS showing effectiveness across diverse models in extracting live web information.

papers.title: MME-Unify: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation Models
papers.contribution: Evaluation of 12 U-MLLMs reveals significant improvements needed in instruction following and image generation quality, providing comprehensive assessment framework.

papers.title: OCR-Reasoning Benchmark: Unveiling the True Capabilities of MLLMs in Complex Text-Rich Image Reasoning
papers.contribution: Comprehensive evaluation shows advanced MLLMs exhibit substantial difficulties in text-rich reasoning, with none achieving 50% accuracy, revealing an urgent gap to address.

papers.title: Seeing Through Deception: Uncovering Misleading Creator Intent in Multimodal News with Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that current VLMs struggle with intent reasoning and rely on shallow cues, establishing DeceptionDecoded as a foundation for developing intent-aware models for multimodal misinformation detection.

papers.title: SpaCE-Eval: A Benchmark for Real-World Multi-Modal Reasoning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that leading MLLMs significantly underperform on spatial reasoning, indicating substantial enhancement necessary for real-world environmental understanding.

papers.title: Spatial CAPTCHA: Generatively Benchmarking Spatial Reasoning for Human-Machine Differentiation
papers.contribution: Humans vastly outperform 10 state-of-the-art MLLMs; best model achieves only 31.0% Pass@1 accuracy, confirming effectiveness as both security mechanism and diagnostic tool.

papers.title: VUDG: A Dataset for Video Understanding Domain Generalization
papers.contribution: Evaluation of 9 representative LVLMs and traditional VQA methods shows most models suffer performance degradation under domain shifts, highlighting challenges in robustness.

papers.title: Video-LevelGauge: Investigating Contextual Positional Bias in Video Language Models.
papers.contribution: Evaluation of 27 state-of-the-art LVLMs reveals significant positional biases in open-source models (head/neighbor-content preferences) while commercial models like Gemini 2.5 Pro show consistent performance across video sequences.

papers.title: VideoMathQA: Benchmarking Mathematical Reasoning via Multimodal Understanding in Video
papers.contribution: Establishes evaluation framework for temporally extended cross-modal mathematical reasoning; demonstrates significant challenge for MLLMs including closed and open-source models.

papers.title: A Structured, Tagged, and Localized Visual Question Answering Dataset with Full Sentence Answers and Scene Graphs for Chest X-ray Images
papers.contribution: The dataset provides 31M pre-training and 7.5M fine-tuning grade QA-pairs with multi-granular answers and bounding boxes, the largest and most sophisticated VQA dataset for chest X-rays.

papers.title: ASCIIEval: Benchmarking Models' Visual Perception in Text Strings via ASCII Art
papers.contribution: Analysis reveals proprietary models (GPT-5 tops rank) exceed open-source MLLMs by 20%+ accuracy; none benefit from simultaneous multimodal provision.

papers.title: AgentExpt: Automating AI Experiment Design with LLM-based Resource Retrieval Agent
papers.contribution: Outperforms strongest baseline with +5.85% Recall@20 and +7.90% HitRate@10 gains.

papers.title: Automatic Image-Level Morphological Trait Annotation for Organismal Images
papers.contribution: Constructs Bioscan-Traits with 80K trait annotations from 19K insect images; improves BioCLIP zero-shot species classification on in-the-wild Insects benchmark.

papers.title: BAH Dataset for Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition in Videos for Behavioural Change
papers.contribution: Introduces first dataset for ambivalence/hesitancy recognition with comprehensive annotations and demonstrates feasibility through multimodal baseline experiments.

papers.title: BabyVision: Visual Reasoning Beyond Language
papers.contribution: Leading MLLMs like Gemini3-Pro-Preview score only 49.7 (vs 94.1 human average), revealing a fundamental gap in visual primitives despite strong performance on knowledge-heavy evaluations.

papers.title: Benchmarking Dense and Indiscernible Object Counting with Blueberries
papers.contribution: Achieves new state-of-the-art, reducing MAE and RMSE by 49.16% and 70.50% respectively with strong generalization to other agricultural scenes.

papers.title: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models on Fine-Grained Image Tasks: A Comprehensive Evaluation
papers.contribution: FG-BMK reveals key findings on training paradigms, modality alignment, perturbation susceptibility, and fine-grained reasoning impacts on LVLMs, providing guidance for future model development.

papers.title: Benchmarking the Scientific Mind: A Pathology-Derived Biomedical VQA Benchmark for Complex Scientific Reasoning
papers.contribution: State-of-the-art biomedical MLLMs show substantial performance degradation under process-oriented evaluation, revealing systematic limitations in evidence grounding and causal reasoning.

papers.title: Can Vision–Language Models Assess Graphic Design Aesthetics? A Benchmark, Evaluation, and Dataset Perspective.
papers.contribution: Establishes first systematic framework for aesthetic assessment in graphic design; reveals clear performance gaps of proprietary, open-source, and reasoning-augmented VLMs.

papers.title: Children's Intelligence Tests Pose Challenges for MLLMs? KidGym: A 2D Grid-Based Reasoning Benchmark for MLLMs
papers.contribution: Evaluation of SOTA MLLMs reveals significant limitations and provides actionable insights into model capabilities.

papers.title: CityLens: Evaluating Large Vision-Language Models for Urban Socioeconomic Sensing
papers.contribution: Our results reveal that while LVLMs demonstrate promising perceptual and reasoning capabilities, they still exhibit limitations in predicting urban socioeconomic indicators.

papers.title: CitySeeker: How Do VLMs Explore Embodied Urban Navigation with Implicit Human Needs?
papers.contribution: Reveals key limitations in error accumulation, spatial cognition, and experiential recall; provides actionable insights for developing robust spatial intelligence in VLMs.

papers.title: CubeBench: Diagnosing Interactive, Long-Horizon Physical Intelligence under Partial Observations
papers.contribution: Reveals uniform 0.00% pass rate on long-horizon tasks, exposing fundamental failures in long-term planning and identifying cognitive bottlenecks.

papers.title: Dataset Color Quantization: A Training-Oriented Framework for Dataset-Level Compression
papers.contribution: DCQ significantly improves training performance under aggressive compression on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, and ImageNet-1K, offering scalable dataset-level storage reduction.

papers.title: Do 3D Large Language Models Really Understand 3D Spatial Relationships?
papers.contribution: Real-3DQA confirms existing 3D-LLMs struggle with spatial relationships when simple cues are removed, and 3D-reweighted training substantially enhances performance.

papers.title: Do Vision-Language Models Respect Contextual Integrity in Location Disclosure?
papers.contribution: 14 leading VLMs poorly align with human privacy expectations, over-disclosing in sensitive contexts and vulnerable to prompt attacks.

papers.title: Dynamic Multimodal Evaluation via Knowledge-Enhanced Benchmark Evolution
papers.contribution: KBE effectively mitigates data contamination and benchmark saturation while enabling difficulty-controllable evaluation across a wide range of model capabilities for multimodal language models.

papers.title: EchoMind: An Interrelated Multi-level Benchmark for Evaluating Empathetic Speech Language Models
papers.contribution: Testing 12 SLMs reveals that even state-of-the-art models struggle with high-expressive vocal cues and fail to leverage vocal cues for empathy generation.

papers.title: Evaluating Cross-Modal Reasoning Ability and Problem Charactaristics with Multimodal Item Response Theory
papers.contribution: Identifies cross-modal questions over shortcuts, preserves ranking fidelity with 50% artificially generated low-quality items, reducing evaluation cost while improving reliability.

papers.title: Evaluating Object-Centric Models beyond Object Discovery
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that OCL representation usefulness varies significantly across datasets, establishing more comprehensive evaluation paradigm.

papers.title: Everything in Its Place: Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence of Text-to-Image Models
papers.contribution: Reveals higher-order spatial reasoning as primary bottleneck; fine-tuned models show consistent gains (+4.2% to +5.7%) with more realistic spatial relations.

papers.title: ExpVid: A Benchmark for Experiment Video Understanding & Reasoning
papers.contribution: 3.6K condition sets across six tasks and domains with 20K fine-grained annotations reveal that MLLMs excel at coarse recognition but struggle with details and high-order reasoning.

papers.title: FETAL-GAUGE: A BENCHMARK FOR ASSESSING VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS IN FETAL ULTRASOUND
papers.contribution: Systematic evaluation reveals the best-performing VLM achieves only 55% accuracy far below clinical requirements, identifying critical limitations in domain-specific VLM adaptation.

papers.title: FLUX-Reason-6M & PRISM-Bench: A Million-Scale Text-to-Image Reasoning Dataset and Comprehensive Benchmark
papers.contribution: FLUX-Reason-6M and PRISM-Bench enable training and evaluation of open-source text-to-image models with comprehensive reasoning assessment across 19 leading models.

papers.title: FloorplanQA: A Benchmark for Spatial Reasoning in LLMs using Structured Representations
papers.contribution: Reveals inconsistent spatial reasoning: models succeed on shallow queries but fail on constrained spaces; mostly robust to small perturbations.

papers.title: From EduVisBench to EduVisAgent: A Benchmark and Multi-Agent Framework for Reasoning-Driven Pedagogical Visualization
papers.contribution: EduVisAgent achieves 40.2% improvement over baselines and delivers more educationally aligned visualizations grounded in pedagogical theory.

papers.title: GTR-Bench: Evaluating Geo-Temporal Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Benchmark shows top VLMs like Gemini-2.5-Pro achieve only 34.9% accuracy versus 78.61% human performance, revealing three key deficiencies in spatial-temporal reasoning.

papers.title: GePBench: Evaluating Fundamental Geometric Perception for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Reveals significant deficiencies in state-of-the-art MLLMs, and shows that models trained with GePBench data improve substantially on downstream tasks.

papers.title: GeoBench: Rethinking Multimodal Geometric Problem-Solving via Hierarchical Evaluation
papers.contribution: Reveals reasoning models like OpenAI-o3 outperform general MLLMs but performance declines with complexity; shows sub-goal decomposition and premise filtering critically influence accuracy.

papers.title: Go Beyond Earth: Understanding Human Actions and Scenes in Microgravity Environments
papers.contribution: The dataset includes 4,759 clips covering 50 actions with 1,238 captions and 7,000 QA pairs, establishing baselines for action recognition, captioning, and VQA.

papers.title: HEARTS: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning on Health Time Series
papers.contribution: Reveals that LLMs substantially underperform specialized models, rely on simple heuristics, struggle with multi-step temporal reasoning, and that scaling alone is insufficient.

papers.title: Holi-Spatial: Evolving Video Streams into Holistic 3D Spatial Intelligence
papers.contribution: Constructs Holi-Spatial-4M with 12K optimized 3DGS scenes, 1.3M 2D masks, 320K 3D bounding boxes, 320K instance captions, and 1.2M spatial QA pairs, demonstrating exceptional data quality.

papers.title: Human-MME: A Holistic Evaluation Benchmark for Human-Centric Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Human-MME's high-quality annotations with diverse data paradigms and 43 sub-fields enable precise assessment of MLLMs on human-centric scene understanding spanning multi-person and multi-image reasoning.

papers.title: IF-VidCap: Can Video Caption Models Follow Instructions?
papers.contribution: Evaluation of 19 models shows top-tier open-source MLLMs now achieve near-parity with proprietary models, though specialized dense captioning models underperform on complex instructions.

papers.title: IV-Bench: A Benchmark for Image-Grounded Video Perception and Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
papers.contribution: Current models achieve at most 28.9% accuracy, revealing key performance factors including inference pattern, frame number, and resolution.

papers.title: IVEBench: Modern Benchmark Suite for Instruction-Guided Video Editing Assessment
papers.contribution: IVEBench establishes comprehensive evaluation with video quality, instruction compliance, and video fidelity metrics integrated with multimodal LLM assessments.

papers.title: IWR-Bench: Can LVLMs reconstruct interactive webpage from a user interaction video?
papers.contribution: Experiments reveal that the best LVLM model achieves only 36.35% overall score with functional correctness (24.39%) lagging visual fidelity (64.25%), highlighting critical limitations in reasoning about temporal dynamics.

papers.title: Image Quality Assessment for Embodied AI
papers.contribution: Establishes first IQA benchmark for embodied AI, demonstrating need for quality indicators tailored to robot perception under distortions.

papers.title: IndicVisionBench: Benchmarking Cultural and Multilingual Understanding in VLMs
papers.contribution: Evaluation of 8 models reveals substantial performance gaps, demonstrating significant limitations of current VLMs in culturally diverse contexts.

papers.title: InternSpatial: A Comprehensive Dataset for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Recent benchmarks and datasets have been proposed to improve spatial reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs), yet existing open resources remain limited in scale, visual diversity, and instruction

papers.title: JointAVBench: A Benchmark for Joint Audio-Visual Reasoning Evaluation
papers.contribution: Shows best Omni-LLM achieves 62.6% accuracy outperforming uni-modal baselines but revealing substantial room for improvement in cross-scene reasoning.

papers.title: LLMs as Rules Oracles: Exploring Real-World Multimodal Reasoning in Tabletop Strategy Game Environments
papers.contribution: Shows frontier LMs achieve only ~68% on simple perception and <10% on situated multi-step comprehension, revealing failures in cross-modal reference knowledge and application.

papers.title: M3CoTBench: Benchmark Chain-of-Thought of MLLMs in Medical Image Understanding
papers.contribution: The benchmark reveals current limitations of MLLMs in generating reliable and clinically interpretable reasoning for medical images.

papers.title: MCIF: Multimodal Crosslingual Instruction-Following Benchmark from Scientific Talks
papers.contribution: Systematic evaluation of 23 models reveals universal challenges across modalities and languages, indicating substantial room for improvement in future MLLMs.

papers.title: MMClima: A Framework for Multimodal Climate Science Data and Evaluation
papers.contribution: Releases 104k+ expert-validated QA pairs and demonstrates that domain-adapted fine-tuning outperforms strong open and closed-source models on textual QA, enabling standardized multimodal climate evaluation.

papers.title: MME-Reasoning: A Broad-Spectrum Benchmark for Evaluating Logical Reasoning in MLLMs
papers.contribution: Reveals substantial limitations of state-of-the-art MLLMs in comprehensive logical reasoning, with notable performance imbalances across reasoning types.

papers.title: MMKU-Bench: A Multimodal Update Benchmark for Diverse Visual Knowledge
papers.contribution: Reveals that SFT and RLHF suffer catastrophic forgetting while knowledge editing preserves general capabilities but has limitations in continual updating, providing reliable evaluation infrastructure.

papers.title: MMR-V: What's Left Unsaid? A Benchmark for Multimodal Deep Reasoning in Videos
papers.contribution: Reveals that even the best-performing model (Gemini-2.5-pro) achieves only 64.3% accuracy and that current reasoning enhancement strategies bring limited gains, indicating a gap in multimodal reasoning capabilities.

papers.title: MMSI-Bench: A Benchmark for Multi-Image Spatial Intelligence
papers.contribution: Reveals wide gap between open-source (≈30%) and proprietary models (40% for GPT-5), identifies dominant failure modes including grounding and spatial-logic errors.

papers.title: MORALISE: A Structured Benchmark for Moral Alignment in Visual Language Models
papers.contribution: Extensive experiments on 19 VLMs reveal variable moral alignment and identify patterns in moral violations across different model types.

papers.title: MechVQA: Benchmarking and Enhancing Multimodal LLMs on Comprehensive Mechanical Drawing Understanding
papers.contribution: Outperforms strongest baseline by 7.57 percentage points on MechVQA, establishing domain-specialized foundation for deploying MLLMs in mechanical design and inspection.

papers.title: OmniSpatial: Towards Comprehensive Spatial Reasoning Benchmark for Vision Language Models
papers.contribution: Reveals significant limitations of current VLMs in comprehensive spatial reasoning and proposes PointGraph and SpatialCoT strategies to improve reasoning.

papers.title: PerceptionRubrics: Calibrating Multimodal Evaluation to Human Perception
papers.contribution: Reveals persistent 5% perception deficit between open-source and proprietary models, demonstrates fragmented element verification despite poor conjunctive constraint satisfaction, and achieves better human alignment than conventional benchmarks.

papers.title: RAVENEA: A Benchmark for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Visual Culture Understanding
papers.contribution: Shows VLMs augmented with culture-aware retrieval outperform non-augmented counterparts by averaging +6% on cVQA and +11% on cIC.

papers.title: RIVER: Real-time Video Interaction Benchmark
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that offline models struggle with real-time processing and proposes a general improvement method enabling flexible real-time user interaction.

papers.title: ROAMM: A Benchmark Dataset for Multimodal Human Attention Decoding and EEG-to-Text Modeling During Naturalistic Reading
papers.contribution: Establishes benchmarks for mind-wandering detection (up to 0.609 AUROC) and demonstrates that EEG-to-text decoding performance decreases during mind-wandering episodes.

papers.title: Read the Room: Video Social Reasoning with Mental-Physical Causal Chains
papers.contribution: Shows SOTA LVLMs fall far short of human-level reasoning on R3-Bench; fine-tuning 7B model with GRPO on R3-FDT achieves notable improvements across multiple social reasoning benchmarks.

papers.title: Ref-Adv: Exploring MLLM Visual Reasoning in Referring Expression Tasks
papers.contribution: Despite strong results on RefCOCO, MLLMs drop markedly on Ref-Adv, exposing reliance on shortcuts and gaps in visual reasoning and grounding.

papers.title: RobotArena $\infty$: Unlimited Robot Benchmarking via Real-to-Sim Translation
papers.contribution: Overcomes limitations of real-world and simulation-only benchmarks by enabling large-scale VLA evaluation with online human feedback for nuanced execution quality judgments.

papers.title: SAW-Bench: Learning Situated Awareness in the Real World
papers.contribution: Reveals a 37.66% human-model performance gap and shows models fail to infer coherent camera geometry despite exploiting partial geometric cues.

papers.title: SCoT: Teaching 3D-LLMs to Think Spatially with Million-scale CoT Annotations
papers.contribution: Shows CoT supervision greatly benefits complex analysis and planning but can induce hallucinations in simple perception tasks, highlighting nuanced challenges of scene-grounded reasoning.

papers.title: STAR-Bench: Probing Deep Spatio-Temporal Reasoning as Audio 4D Intelligence
papers.contribution: Induces large accuracy drops (-31.5% temporal, -35.2% spatial) compared to caption-only answering, revealing gaps between models and human performance.

papers.title: ScaleLong: A Multi-Timescale Benchmark for Long Video Understanding
papers.contribution: Evaluation of 22 MLLMs reveals a U-shaped performance trend with higher accuracy at shortest and longest timescales, providing a fine-grained multi-timescale benchmark.

papers.title: Seeing Across Views: Benchmarking Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in Robotic Scenes
papers.contribution: Reveals state-of-the-art models fall far below human performance and strong single-view benchmarks poorly predict multi-view robotic performance.

papers.title: SpatiaLab: Can Vision–Language Models Perform Spatial Reasoning in the Wild?
papers.contribution: Reveals substantial gaps in spatial reasoning: InternVL3.5-72B achieves 54.93% vs 87.57% human accuracy, showing key limitations in complex spatial understanding.

papers.title: Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models in Ego-Centric Multi-View Scenes
papers.contribution: VLMs show performance gaps relative to humans; Ego3D-VLM improves multi-choice QA by 12% and distance estimation by 56%.

papers.title: SpatialViz-Bench: A Cognitively-Grounded Benchmark for Diagnosing Spatial Visualization in MLLMs
papers.contribution: Evaluation of 27 MLLMs reveals wide performance variations and counter-intuitive finding that CoT prompting paradoxically degrades accuracy on open-source models.

papers.title: SpinBench: Perspective and Rotation as a Lens on Spatial Reasoning in VLMs
papers.contribution: Since perspective taking requires multiple cognitive capabilities, such as recognizing objects across views, relative positions grounding, and mentally simulating transformations, SpinBench introduces a set of fine-grained diagnostic categories.

papers.title: TABLET: A Large-Scale Dataset for Robust Visual Table Understanding
papers.contribution: Fine-tuning vision-language models on TABLET improves performance on seen/unseen VTU tasks while increasing robustness on real-world table visualizations.

papers.title: TMD-Bench: A Multi-Level Evaluation Paradigm for Music–Dance Co-Generation
papers.contribution: Reveals that commercial audio-visual models produce high-quality outputs but leave rhythmic coupling suboptimal, establishing evaluation standard for music-dance generation.

papers.title: TPRU: Advancing Temporal and Procedural Understanding in Large Multimodal Models
papers.contribution: TPRU-7B accuracy improved from 50.33% to 75.70% on TPRU-Test, achieving state-of-the-art results that significantly outperform GPT-4o.

papers.title: TSRBench: A Comprehensive Multi-task Multi-modal Time Series Reasoning Benchmark for Generalist Models
papers.contribution: TSRBench reveals scaling laws hold for perception/reasoning but break for prediction, strong reasoning doesn't guarantee accurate forecasting, and multimodal models fail to effectively fuse text/visual time series despite complementary nature.

papers.title: Theory of Space: Can Foundation Models Construct Spatial Beliefs through Active Exploration?
papers.contribution: Evaluation of state-of-the-art models reveals critical bottlenecks in active exploration and spatial reasoning, with performance degrading significantly when agents must autonomously gather information.

papers.title: U2-BENCH: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models on Ultrasound Understanding
papers.contribution: Evaluates 23 LVLMs revealing strong image-level classification but persistent challenges in spatial reasoning and clinical language generation.

papers.title: Unfolding Spatial Cognition: Evaluating Multimodal Models on Visual Simulations
papers.contribution: Evaluations reveal models perform near random chance on complex spatial tasks requiring multi-step visual simulation, while humans achieve near-perfect accuracy despite longer completion times.

papers.title: UrbanFeel：A Comprehensive Benchmark for Temporal and Perceptual Understanding of City Scenes through Human Perspective
papers.contribution: Evaluation of 20 MLLMs shows Gemini-2.5 Pro achieves best performance approaching human expert levels, revealing models perform well on scene understanding but struggle with subjective environmental perception.

papers.title: V2P-Bench: Evaluating Video-Language Understanding with Visual Prompts for Better Human-Model Interaction
papers.contribution: Analysis shows visual prompts are more model-friendly and user-friendly than text prompts, revealing LVLMs struggle with spatiotemporal understanding and exhibit hack phenomena.

papers.title: VLM-RobustBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robustness of Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Reveals VLMs are semantically strong but spatially fragile, with low-severity spatial perturbations degrading performance more than visually severe photometric corruptions.

papers.title: VaseVQA-3D: Benchmarking 3D VLMs on Ancient Greek Pottery
papers.contribution: VaseVLM-7B-RL achieves 12.8% improvement in R@1 accuracy and 6.6% improvement in lexical similarity on the VaseVQA-3D dataset compared to strongest baselines.

papers.title: VideoKR: Towards Knowledge- and Reasoning-Intensive Video Understanding
papers.contribution: Models post-trained on VideoKR via SFT→GRPO outperform prior approaches on knowledge-intensive video reasoning while remaining competitive on general video understanding.

papers.title: VisuLogic: A Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Reasoning in Multi-modal Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Leading MLLMs score below 30% accuracy versus 51.4% human performance, revealing significant gaps in visual reasoning and establishing benchmark for evaluation.

papers.title: VisualPuzzles: Decoupling Multimodal Reasoning Evaluation from Domain Knowledge
papers.contribution: Shows state-of-the-art MLLMs significantly lag behind human performance on reasoning-light tasks and that reasoning enhancements yield inconsistent gains across models.

papers.title: ZeroBench: An Impossible Visual Benchmark for Contemporary Large Multimodal Models
papers.contribution: Initial SotA was 0% pass@1, reaching 19% pass@5 after one year; ZeroBench demonstrates sustained benchmark difficulty and charts progress on 46 LMMs.

papers.title: lmgame-Bench: How Good are LLMs at Playing Games?
papers.contribution: Evaluation of 13 SOTA models reveals limitations in visual state extraction, reflection, spatiotemporal reasoning, and long-context reasoning.
